outcome: oxidative stress markers (malondialdehyde (MDA), total antioxidant capacity (TAC), paraoxonase-1 (PON1))
cohort: 44 Egyptian neonates with IUGR and 45 Egyptian neonates with appropriate for gestational age, born vaginally at 37-41 weeks gestation to mothers without known medical conditions affecting placental sufficiency.
finding: Neonates with IUGR had increased MDA activity and lower levels of TAC and PON1 compared to controls, as well as lower APGAR scores, birth weight, length, and head circumference.
birth_weight: Not specified (but lower in IUGR group)
